subject: Evening security rehearsal & vendor bridge — proposed plan and backup attendees
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@dockbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortega <lina.ortega@dockbank.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evening security rehearsal + evidence handoff

Hi Diego —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We wanted to run a short rehearsal with your team this month to validate the ops runbook, verify the evidence handoff flow, and confirm fallback behavior for an evening window (approximately 60 minutes). Our compliance schedule pushes most of our staff to late afternoons, so an after-hours slot is the only workable option for DockBank.

Can you propose a concrete plan for:
- A 60-minute rehearsal (hands-on, not just slides)
- A short dry-run of the SFTP/evidence transfer and the access checklist
- A backup attendee from Redwood in case Diego or the primary on-call needs to drop

We’re aiming for the week of June 23–27 but can be flexible if you have earlier evening capacity. I’ve attached the latest security checklist.

Appreciate it —
Alex Ramos
Senior Security Program Manager
DockBank

Attachment: DockBank_Security_Checklist_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@dockbank.com>
Cc: Lina Ortega <lina.ortega@dockbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evening security rehearsal + evidence handoff

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the checklist — good framing. We can run a hands-on 60-minute rehearsal that includes:
1) 15m: Quick run-through of control map & access roles (we’ll use the controls spreadsheet)
2) 25m: Live SFTP evidence transfer (we’ll push a sanitized sample object) and validation
3) 10m: KV/cache and runtime behavior Q&A (short)
4) 10m: Failure/fallback scenario (model variant fallback + rollback plan)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 24 — 6:30pm–7:30pm
- Wed Jun 25 — 7:00pm–8:00pm
- Thu Jun 26 — 6:00pm–7:00pm

Please pick a preferred slot and we’ll send the calendar invite.

Backup attendee: Ben Carter will be on the call to cover the ops lane if I need to step out. Irene will join for evidence-transfer validation. Marissa Cole (cc’d) will be on standby for runbook notes and follow-ups.

I’ll attach a brief rehearsal agenda and an .ics invite once you confirm the slot.

Diego Fernandez
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evening-rehearsal-agenda.ics (text/calendar)
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@dockbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortega <lina.ortega@dockbank.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 12:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evening security rehearsal + evidence handoff

Diego —

Thanks, that looks good. DockBank prefers Wed Jun 25, 7:00pm–8:00pm PST. Lina and I will both be on the call. Can you confirm Ben and Irene as backups? Also, can we get a pre-rehearsal checklist from you that lists what sanitized sample files will look like and where we should push them (SFTP path)?

If we need to swap to the 6:30pm start, please flag it now — our team runs a close-of-day batch at 6pm and some engineers may be delayed.

Alex
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@dockbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Perfect — Wed Jun 25, 7:00pm–8:00pm PST is confirmed from our side.

Summary / action items before the rehearsal:
- Redwood will send an invite with dial-in + Zoom and the rehearsal agenda (I attached the .ics).
- Redwood (Irene) will provide the sanitized sample file format and the SFTP path by Tue Jun 24 EOD. Expect: sample_evidence_YYYYMMDD.json (no PII), ~50KB, sha256 checksum included.
- DockBank to confirm final attendee roster by Tue Jun 24 5pm PST. If any DockBank engineer expects a 6:30pm start requirement, flag it ASAP — we can move to 6:30pm if needed.
- Ben is backup for ops lane; Marissa will capture runbook notes and follow-ups.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-dockbank-rehearsal-62319
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEV-RehearsalDocs

See you Wed — thank you.

Diego Fernandez
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
